## Problem

`bedrock-spend-cap` computes fast spend from CloudWatch token counts multiplied by empirical Cost Explorer rates. On `origin/main`, `_refresh_rates()` cannot load empirical Claude Bedrock Edition rates, so `_rate_for()` falls through to seeds or `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K` for unseeded Claude models. The visible symptom is Sonnet 4.5 pricing through the fail-closed fallback instead of account billing data.

## Baseline and sequencing

Read these paths from `origin/main`: `infra/terraform/bedrock-spend-cap/handler.py` and `tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py`. Both paths resolve with `git show origin/main:<path>`.

Two siblings land first. `604c-ade8` is already committed; it changes `_ce_spend_today`, the CE poll near-threshold guard, and the dry-run release notification. `cfe0-4b2b` is in plan review; it changes `_metered_spend` to return `MeteredSpend(total, degraded, failures)` for partial region failure. Neither sibling touches `_refresh_rates()`, `_rate_for()`, `_match()`, `_normalise()`, or `_seed_for()`, so the line references below use the `origin/main` baseline.

## Current code facts

`_refresh_rates()` filters CE to one service at `handler.py:184-190`: `Filter={"Dimensions": {"Key": "SERVICE", "Values": ["Amazon Bedrock"]}}` plus `GroupBy=[{"Type": "DIMENSION", "Key": "USAGE_TYPE"}]`. It stores the raw CE usage type as the rate key: `usage_type = group["Keys"][0]` at `handler.py:194`, then `usage_type: cost / qty` at `handler.py:201-203`.

`_rate_for()` compares those keys to a CloudWatch `ModelId`. It sets `target = pin or _normalise(model_id)` at `handler.py:236-241`. `_match()` only considers keys ending in a token suffix at `handler.py:246-248`, strips that suffix at `handler.py:250`, strips the first hyphen-delimited prefix at `handler.py:251`, computes `norm = _normalise(body)` at `handler.py:252`, then accepts `norm == target or norm in target or target in norm` at `handler.py:255`. `_normalise()` strips stacked provider prefixes then removes non-alphanumerics at `handler.py:150-177`. `_seed_for()` is only substring seed lookup at `handler.py:208-223`.

A raw service key such as `Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Amazon Bedrock Edition)` cannot match because it has no suffix such as `input-tokens`. Its normalised service form is `claudesonnet45amazonbedrockedition`, which does not match target `claudesonnet4520250929v10` for `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0`.

## Required bridge

Change `_refresh_rates()` so Claude Bedrock Edition CE rows produce keys in the shape that `_match()` already parses. The loader must preserve service identity by grouping or otherwise reading both `SERVICE` and `USAGE_TYPE` for Claude Bedrock Edition rows. For CE service `Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Amazon Bedrock Edition)`, strip the exact suffix ` (Amazon Bedrock Edition)` to get model label `Claude Sonnet 4.5`.

For Marketplace usage type `USE1-MP:USE1_InputTokenCount-Units`, derive region `USE1`, map `InputTokenCount` to existing suffix `input-tokens`, and store the empirical rate under `USE1-Claude Sonnet 4.5-input-tokens`. For the same service, map `OutputTokenCount` to `output-tokens`, `CacheReadInputTokenCount` to `cache-read-input-token-count`, and `CacheWriteInputTokenCount` to `cache-write-input-token-count`. Convert Marketplace `*-Units` quantities to per-1,000-token rates with `cost / quantity / 1000`; leave legacy Amazon Bedrock `*-tokens` quantities at `cost / quantity`.

This bridge deliberately relies on `_match()`'s existing substring relation. With key `USE1-Claude Sonnet 4.5-input-tokens`, `_match()` strips to body `Claude Sonnet 4.5`; `_normalise(body)` is `claudesonnet45`. For CloudWatch model id `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0`, `_normalise(model_id)` is `claudesonnet4520250929v10`. The required comparison is `claudesonnet45 in claudesonnet4520250929v10`.

Keep `_rate_for()` precedence: exact empirical direction, seed, empirical input scaled by metric multiplier, then fail-closed fallback. If implementation changes the helper return type to expose source metadata, preserve the numeric rate returned to existing callers or update all callers in the same patch.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `_refresh_rates()` reads `SERVICE` identity for Claude Bedrock Edition CE rows.
- [ ] `_refresh_rates()` still reads `USAGE_TYPE` identity for rate direction.
- [ ] `Claude Sonnet 4.5 (Amazon Bedrock Edition)` is reduced to model label `Claude Sonnet 4.5`.
- [ ] `USE1-MP:USE1_InputTokenCount-Units` is mapped to suffix `input-tokens`.
- [ ] `USE1-MP:USE1_OutputTokenCount-Units` is mapped to suffix `output-tokens`.
- [ ] `USE1-MP:USE1_CacheReadInputTokenCount-Units` is mapped to suffix `cache-read-input-token-count`.
- [ ] `USE1-MP:USE1_CacheWriteInputTokenCount-Units` is mapped to suffix `cache-write-input-token-count`.
- [ ] A Sonnet 4.5 input CE row produces key `USE1-Claude Sonnet 4.5-input-tokens` in the returned rates dict.
- [ ] The rate for `USE1-Claude Sonnet 4.5-input-tokens` equals `UnblendedCost / UsageQuantity / 1000`.
- [ ] `_rate_for("us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0", "InputTokenCount", rates)` returns `rates["USE1-Claude Sonnet 4.5-input-tokens"]`.
- [ ] The Sonnet 4.5 end-to-end test fails if the derived key is renamed to a raw service string.
- [ ] A non-Claude `Amazon Bedrock` usage type such as `USE1-model-input-tokens` keeps the existing `cost / quantity` rate.
- [ ] A model priced only by `SEED_RATES` marks the metered component as estimated.
- [ ] A model priced by `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K` marks the metered component as estimated.
- [ ] The handler return payload includes `metered_estimated: true` when metered spend includes a seed rate.
- [ ] The handler return payload includes `metered_estimated: true` when metered spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [ ] The saved SSM state includes `metered_estimated: true` after a run whose metered spend includes a seed rate.
- [ ] The saved SSM state includes `metered_estimated: true` after a run whose metered spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [ ] Warning SNS text includes `estimated` when warning spend includes a seed rate.
- [ ] Trip SNS text includes `estimated` when trip spend includes `UNKNOWN_RATE_PER_1K`.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py` exits 0.
- [ ] `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` exits 0.

## Testing

During development run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py -k 'refresh_rates or rate_for_claude_sonnet_45 or estimated'`. Before push run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" pytest tests/infra/test_bedrock_spend_cap_handler.py`. Before Gerrit push run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify`.

## Out of scope

Do not change Terraform ownership of the live Lambda. Do not redesign the spend guard around per-session attribution. Do not change `_ce_spend_today()` in this ticket; sibling `604c-ade8` already owns its current fix path.
